prompt: Create a polished realistic illustrated miniature for our scientific chart. note: Interpretive illustration. Mission photos constrain observed shapes; unresolved and unlit detail is inferred. Exoplanets and Psyche are artist interpretations, not resolved photographs.

lighting.prompt: Edit this 55-cnc-e artist illustration into an UNSHADED ALBEDO DISC for later multiplication with our standard white sphere lighting template.
